issues.claim: 遇到深冠筒的花,欧洲熊蜂常在花冠基部咬孔取蜜,这种行为叫"盗蜜"
issues.problem: Bombus terrestris 专页未提盗蜜;由 Bumblebee 页与 Nectar robbing 页共同支持(B. terrestris 本种的盗蜜证据来自 Nectar robbing 页图注)。'常'为频率表述,来源未量化,属轻微措辞问题,不影响裁决。
issues.evidence: Bumblebee 页:'Many species of bumblebees also exhibit nectar robbing: instead of inserting the mouthparts into the flower in the normal way, these bees bite directly through the base of the corolla to extract nectar';Nectar robbing 页:'long flowers with tubular corollas are prone to robbing'、'Short-tongued bees ... are unable to reach the nectar located at the base of long flowers ... enter the flower through a hole bitten at the base',图注 'Bombus terrestris stealing nectar'。
issues.fix: 可选:将'常在'改为'会在',更贴合来源措辞。

issues.claim: 同一巢的工蜂胸部长度可差两三倍,体重可差十倍以上

issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons 页:'closes off the cell with mud'(无词源说明);Exotic Bee ID:'Nest cells are constructed of mud and leaf pulp'(无词源说明)。仓库内 src-wikipedia-mason-bee(本条未引用)可支持:'Mason bees are named for their habit of using mud or other masonry products in constructing their nests'。
